text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ......Mother.

text_block_list.name: Late Mother
text_block_list.text:
“—Yes, that concludes
our regular training menu.”

text_block_list.name: Late Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Other than that, I try to cherish each day,
and live with sincerity."

text_block_list.name: Late Mother
text_block_list.text:
"‘Stacking things up steadily and surely.’
That is precisely how one builds a solid foundation."

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Wah... Waaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(So cool! So cool...!!
My mother is...)

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Mother is the best!!
She's more wonderful than anyone else...!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Mother,

text_block_list.name: Late Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! This notebook...
Did you fill all of this out yourself?

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... Yes. Just the other day,
Mother showed me hers, so—

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I tried my best to copy it!
...Did I do it well?

text_block_list.name: Young Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"If I keep trying my best like this...
Will I be able to become like Mother... someday?!"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Mother, ...I—!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My name is Air Messiah.
I enrolled at Tracen Academy because I admired my mother.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: My goal is—conquering the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Through victory, I will surely prove it.
The strength passed down from my mother.
The nobility of the blood flowing through my veins.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —Without fail.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I... I managed to see it through.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I saw it through to the end, Mother...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah is 1st!!
Taking the final leg of the Triple Tiara,
Air Messiah seizes a spectacular victory!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The passing of the torch is complete, blossoming here and now!
Within those unleashed, thunderous legs, truly!
The spirit of her mother resides!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Deeply moved by the cheers that echoed endlessly, I waited for Air Messiah's return in the underground tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just for today, it's a bit of a special situation.
Not just by myself, but—"

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Thank you for inviting me.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
For allowing me to be present...
at such a wonderful moment for my daughter.
choice_data_list: No. Please... make sure to show her how much you appreciate her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Today, together with her mother... squinting our eyes, we gaze into the light and wait.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...! Mother—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much
for coming today.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Being able to stand proud today and deliver this victory to Mother...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: As her daughter, I feel immense pride.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: Messiah...

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Mm, yeah. ...Yeah, ...yeah.
Yeah...--

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed teary-eyed when she first appeared,
so why did she wipe them away so quickly?
In that moment, I understood completely.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Thank you so much, Messiah...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes... Mother.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was surely to take in her mother's tears—to etch them clearly into a vision unclouded by even the slightest mist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I'll go ahead and prepare for the live performance.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, if you could escort my mother
to the stands—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
H-Huh!?
Air Groove-senpai... and even Shakur-san!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Messiah.
Sorry, I made myself at home while waiting inside.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all.
I never imagined that you would come—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Messiah held back her tears in front of her mother.
She looked grand, noble, and deeply respectable.
...Yet, that's precisely why.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Air Messiah... you did magnificently well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I'm truly glad. Air Groove's voice was so endlessly gentle, and Air Shakur was right here with me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"A fierce, proud battle between mother and daughter.
The glory you reached... was truly magnificent."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: U-Ughhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ugh, hic... Uuuughhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, don't hold it back.
Just for right now, let it out.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You've accomplished it all.
Isn't that... enough for now?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what are you looking away for?
Stop trying to hide your embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? Who the hell—!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hit a sore spot, did I?
Come now, is that any way to treat the great Maiden of the Shuka?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: No, like I'm trying to say...!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Shakur—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaargh, DAMMIT!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Talk about sheer, crazy stubbornness.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: And they say she saw it through to the end—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ha... You're seriously out of your mind.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Air Messiah finally burst into tears
in Air Shakur's arms, I found myself
tearing up as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, as I secretly wiped my eyes—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Aargh, it's over, it's over!
...Wait, hang on.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Isn't this kind of thing your job in the first place, bastard?!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Pushed lightly from behind, she stumbles forward,
and in a frantic rush to keep her from falling, I step forward—
causing our movements to accidentally intertwine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The startling warmth radiating from her body as we made contact
was unmistakably the heat of someone who had achieved greatness.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, kh...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...Physical distance and conversational distance
are totally out of sync."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Leave them be.
That's just the way those two are.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And it's precisely because of who they are that they've made it here today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having finally achieved victory in the Shuka Sho, surrounded by supportive eyes, we broke down in shared joy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...However, this is by no means the final stop on Air Messiah's path."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I wish to run in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the Shuka Sho.
At a home party celebrating her victory, she shared those thoughts with me.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"The Queen Elizabeth II Cup...!
The turnaround is a bit tight, but will you be alright?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I would love to join that race where all Tiara Umamusume—including the Senior class—gather to compete for the throne.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: As a representative of the Tiara Umamusume of the current Classic generation... absolutely.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "I do not believe all our objectives were fulfilled at the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"I intend to continue making my presence felt
on the Tiara route."
choice_data_list: Yeah. In that case, let's prepare together!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes. I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, it feels like you're totally
about to start a meeting right this second."

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Mejiro and Trainer too,
today is all about celebrating first, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Younger Sister
text_block_list.text: Come on, your big brother even came all the way back from studying abroad in South Korea just for this!

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Older Brother
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, don't worry about me.
In order to do our best for the Queen Elizabeth II Cup,
can we just take a breather for now? What do you two say?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, indeed. Um...
Shall we get back to the party?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that night, as we headed back to the academy,
Air Messiah's mother saw us off, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Mother, it's getting late, so let's call it here.
I had a wonderful time at the party today.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Having fully restored my strength, even at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, I shall uphold Mother's—

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Messiah.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ah... pardon?

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You know... for carrying on the torch,
and taking on that burden... thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy that you did that,
saying it was of your own will, your own dream.
...And yet, you see.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text: That was probably because... it was something directed toward the 'past', after all.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Next, I'd like you to think
a little bit about your own "future" as well.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I am your mother, and you are my daughter.
That in itself is something very precious.
Something you have every right to cherish.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Even so—the path you run along
is truly yours and yours alone, after all."

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Take your time.
Try thinking it over with your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Not about 'your path as a daughter.'
About 'your own path.'"
